Defective product. I received the product today and discovered that it was only half filled. I see in the comment section that this is quite a common defect. This is extremely dishonest of Fresh to do something like this to the customers. I would like a full refund or at least send me a jar that is fully filled with the product. I finished one jar of this product in the past and really liked it, so I bought a travel size again. Unfortunately, this time the gel part arrived not filled up. It looked 1/4 less than the cream part, as if someone had used it. However, I am sure the product was new because the box looked pristine. Could it be a batch problem? The previous jar I finished did not have the same issue, but I still finished the gel more quickly than the cream. Now with this jar arrived underfilled, I am sure the gel will run out when I still have half jar of the cream left. If not for this issue I would have given 4-5 stars.

I purchased a face mask based on positive reviews. However, when it arrived, I was disappointed to find that the gel filled less than half of the container, making it appear as though it had been used. I immediately contacted customer service, and they responded with, 'Our rose sleeping gel is not filled up to avoid leakage.' I promptly sent photos to illustrate the issue, but have not received any further communication. I have already requested a return because I don't want to waste any more of my time dealing with such frustrating issues.

I initially received a sample of the Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask with my first order from Fresh. Although it was presented in an annoying little packet (I hate those little packets), my experience was immediately so great that I added the regular size with my 2nd order from Fresh (exactly the reason why they give samples, right??) Does the product make my skin feel plumped and hydrated in the morning when I wake up? Yes - but the real reason I am addicted to it is due to the delivery method and the feel of each of the products. The gel is AMAZING - seriously, I am tempted to dive into the gel and swim around (obviously, I'm very tactile-sensitive). And then the cream, just a very heavenly consistency. I'm not a huge 'rose' scent person but, although it 'does' smell of roses, I've grown to like it (maybe it's a positive association) - and it's an overnight mask, it's not like it's my personal daytime scent (I love the grapefruit) but I look forward to using it every night. For me, this is a win-win-win. I will continue to purchase, for sure!

I chose this trial size mask with the points I had accumulated at a well known beauty supply store. Knowing how well my skin reacts to products with rose and having read reviews on the Fresh line, I was excited and hopeful this dual mask would give me the overnight results I was looking for. I'm acne prone (PCOS), and have combination skin that I'm trying to navigate as it changes with age and hormones. The gel that goes on first feels so good as it's like a cooling sensation that really soaks into my skin, but not too fast. And just before it's done soaking in I apply the cream. You don't need much to cover your whole face & neck. Immediately I have a dewy glowy but what's impressive is how in the morning I can see how much difference my skin looks especially when I compare to other lotions or overnight masks I've tried. From my under eye area to my ears (I'm always looking for something that will plump up my ears and while it sounds weird to some, ears are very telling and you can tell when someone skips treating that skin! Lol) and it moisturizes all of it so well that I just need to spray on my Rose toner (another amazing product that I'm obsessed with) and I keep mine in the fridge for an added cooling and added anti inflammatory effect. My acne has been kept at bay since I found these and added them to my regimen, my skin continues to improve and I'm even going makeup free which is huge for me. I never believe the claims that most products say they will give, but these
